newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Wednesday conducted a round of purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent in the money market, traders said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity in the market after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded above the top of the Bank's 3.75-4.25 percent target range, dealers said.
"There's nothing really going on here, just cash is getting a little tight," said one Toronto-based trader. "There's nothing out of usual."
After the intervention the call loan rate traded at 4.25 percent.
